name: Batched Marching Cubes SDF Extraction
definition: Extracts a 0-level isosurface from a voxelized SDF grid using Marching Cubes, with batched neural network inference to prevent GPU OOM during dense grid evaluation.
summary: Batched Marching Cubes SDF Extraction extracts 0-level isosurfaces from voxelized SDF grids by decoupling neural inference from mesh generation and processing points in fixed-size batches to prevent GPU out-of-memory errors.
